run_train_eval_runner: create a TrainEvalRunner with train and eval dataloaders then call run to start training
create_checkpoint_callback: build a TrainCheckpointCallback that saves checkpoints every N steps with a max number of saved checkpoints
find_recent_checkpoint: use get_most_recent_viable_checkpoint_path to find the latest checkpoint directory containing a .metadata file
save_training_state: call save_state on TrainEvalRunner to persist the training unit state to a checkpoint location
resume_from_checkpoint: call load_state on TrainEvalRunner to restore training state from a checkpoint path or auto-detect the latest
